    • isUndoRedoEnabled

      public static boolean isUndoRedoEnabled(RowSet rs)
      Check if the specified RowSet is currently enabled for undo/redo. The enable state may only change when the RowSet's current row changes.
      Parameters:
      rs - RowSet of interest
      Returns:
      true if undo/redo is OK

    • isUndoRedoEnabled

      public static boolean isUndoRedoEnabled(RSC comp)
      Check if the specified RSC is currently enabled for undo/redo. The enable state may only change when the RowSet's current row changes.

      This method currently delegates to check the rowset. In the future it's possible that per column enable may be implemented.

      Parameters:
      comp - RSC of interest
      Returns:
      true if undo/redo is OK

    • captureInitialValue

      public static void captureInitialValue(RSC comp) throws SQLException
      Make sure the column's undo/redo stack is initialized; the database value (an object) is the base. This must be used before any updates are done to the rowset. Does nothing if base already captured.
      Parameters:
      comp - rowset/column
      Throws:
      SQLException
